content.hook_text: 3 verses when you need to remember who God is

verses.text: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

content.caption:
When life feels heavy, we don't need more information — we need to remember who God is. 💪

These three verses have carried people through battles, anxiety, and uncertainty for thousands of years.

Which one speaks to where you are right now?
